suggested_cuts_in_order.what: Salon Owner Playbook: drop the exclusivity (Competitor A, Competitor B)

findings: Salon Owner Playbook: 5 of its 15 recent long-form videos carry YouTube's paid-promotion flag, and their median (32,832 views) is below the all-video median (44,651), so the integration is priced on the sponsored videos. Median views are 39.1% of subscribers.
Front Desk Files: Reel views swing (P25 is 31.0% of the median), so the offer is a base of $200 plus a bonus per 1,000 views, capped at $900.
Front Desk Files: the rights cost more than the posts. Add-ons come to $1,360 on a $500 target fee, mostly the 12-month paid usage and whitelisting.
The round's target total is $4,170 against a $4,000 budget; cutting in the skill's order (Salon Owner Playbook: drop the exclusivity (Competitor A, Competitor B)) brings it to $3,940.
Lawyer flags: 3, all on Front Desk Files: perpetual reuse, AI likeness use and a cross-border deal.
